{{Quote|I don't know your name&mdash;but I take up your cause. I will not remove your mask until there is justice&mdash;until the Mandalorians have been defeated once and for all.|Revan|<ref name="KotOR 42" />}}
In the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a '''female''' lived as a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] during the early skirmishes of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. In [[3973 BBY]], she participated in the Mandalorians' [[Battle of Cathar|devastation]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Cathar (location)/Legends|Cathar]]. After the Mandalorians defeated the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Species/Legends|people]], the [[Gender/Legends|woman]] tried to dissuade [[Cassus Fett]], who led the attack, from committing [[Speciecide|genocide]] against the Cathar. However, Fett refused, and the Mandalorian female [[Death/Legends|died]] along with the Cathar after Fett ordered their mass execution. [[3963 BBY|Ten years later]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] attempted to find evidence of the battle on Cathar. Revan found the Mandalorian female's [[Revan's mask|helmet]] and donned it, promising not to remove it until he and his [[Revanchist|Jedi faction]] permanently defeated the Mandalorians.

==Biography==
===Battle of Cathar===
{{Quote|Cassus&mdash;''wait''! They're ''defeated''! We don't have to do this!''"<br />"''The Cathar left a stain of dishonor amongst the Mando'ade. Today, I wash it clean in the waters of their own presumption. But if you truly feel they need a defender to stand with them&mdash;then do so, warrior. I salute you.|The Mandalorian female and Cassus Fett|<ref name="KotOR 42" />}}
[[File:Battle_of_Cathar.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Mandalorian female participated in the Battle of Cathar (pictured), but tried to stop the genocide of the Cathar species during it.]]
In the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] lived as a member of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], a warrior culture.<ref name="KotOR 42" /> In [[3973 BBY]],<ref name="Death" /> three years after the Mandalorians began [[Mandalorian Wars|attacking]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="KotOR CG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> the woman accompanied forces led by [[Mandalore the Ultimate]]'s primary strategist [[Cassus Fett]] to the planet [[Cathar (location)/Legends|Cathar]]. During the [[Battle of Cathar]], she helped the Mandalorians drive a large number of the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Species/Legends|species]] into the [[Ocean/Legends|sea]]. After successfully defeating the Cathar, the woman, knowing that Fett intended to commit [[Speciecide|genocide]] against the species, pleaded with Fett to spare them. However, Fett was intent on gaining revenge on the Cathar for their role in defeating the Mandalorians during the Great Sith War and told the woman that she could stand with the Cathar as their defender if she chose to. The Mandalorians launched [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] into the [[Water/Legends|sea]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] the woman and obliterating the Cathar.<ref name="KotOR 42" />

In [[3963 BBY]], during the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]]' invasion of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and his faction of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], known as the [[Revanchist]]s, were on Cathar searching for evidence of the Mandalorians' genocide of the Cathar people. Eventually, a team of Jedi led by [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] member [[Vrook Lamar]] traveled to Cathar and ordered the Revanchists to abandon their efforts and disperse permanently. However, Revan noticed the Mandalorian woman's [[Revan's mask|helmet]] underneath his [[Limb/Legends|feet]] and picked it up. When some light struck the [[Armor/Legends|helmet]], all the Jedi present experienced a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of the Mandalorians' devastation of the Cathar species, and also witnessed the woman's role in the battle and how she tried to defend the Cathar people. After the vision's end, Revan donned the woman's mask, vowing not to remove it until he and his Jedi successfully defeated the Mandalorians.<ref name="KotOR 42" /> The Jedi Knight continued to wear the Mandalorian woman's helmet up to the [[Battle of Malachor V|end]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="KotOR CG" /> Revan also wore her helmet during his reign as [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], before his [[Capture of Darth Revan|capture]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

[[File:RevanIsBorn-KotOR42.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Jedi Knight Revan dons the Mandalorian female's helmet on Cathar and vows to defeat the Mandalorians.]]
The mask, previously thought to be destroyed during Revan's capture, had actually been kept by Jedi Knight [[Bastila Shan]], who would later become his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]]. After Revan had disappeared in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], Shan gave the mask to exiled Jedi [[Meetra Surik]], who followed Revan's trail to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Surik returned the mask to Revan, which sparked the return of all of his memories, but it was later taken by the Sith after his failed [[Attack on the Sith Emperor|attack]] on the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]].<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> Approximately three hundred years later, Revan reacquired the Mandalorian's mask after he was freed, and wore it during the [[Battle of the Foundry|battle]] at the [[Foundry (space station)|Foundry]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]<ref name="The Foundry">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The Foundry}}</ref> He continued to wear it throughout the [[Revanite crisis]] until his death on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]<ref name="The Enemy Within">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=general|The Enemy Within|Yavin 4}}</ref> in [[3637 BBY]].<ref name="TOR date">{{TOR_updates|3.0}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|They were ''beaten''! You didn't have to do it! One of you knew, but you didn't listen!|Revan, referring to the Mandalorian female's attempt to stop the execution of the Cathar|<ref name="KotOR 42" />}}
During the attack on Cathar, the Mandalorian woman believed that the genocide of the Cathar species was unnecessary, feeling that their defeat was enough. She tried to convince Cassus Fett his plan was unnecessary at the cost of her life.<ref name="KotOR 42" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|With the mask, however, Revan was an icon, a symbol.|Meetra Surik, describing the impact of the Mandalorian woman's mask on Revan's image|<ref name="Revan" />}}
The Mandalorian woman used a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] during combat and wore [[gray]] and [[red]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] equipped with a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]]. After her death, Revan took her mask<ref name="KotOR 42" /> and wore it throughout his lifetime.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mandalorian female first appeared in a vision to Revan within a flashback in the [[Knights of the Old Republic 42|forty-second issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series, entitled ''Masks''. The issue was written by [[John Jackson Miller]], pencilled by [[Ron Chan]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="KotOR 42" /> on [[June 17]], [[2009]].<ref name="Release Date">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54361/star_wars_knights_of_the_old_republic_2006_42|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (2006) #42}}</ref>
